feed.title: Ebb Lifecycle Data Changelog
feed.subtitle: Track additions, updates, deprecations and removals in the Ebb lifecycle dataset.

entry.title: Ebb Lifecycle Data 0.4.0 (2026-11-14)
entry.summary: Ebb lifecycle data release 0.4.0: 30 added rules, 12 changed rules across npm, nodejs, python, and more.
entry.content: Ebb lifecycle data release 0.4.0 adds rules for Node 24, Python 3.13, left-pad, and node-sass, with updated citations across the dataset.

entry.title: Ebb Lifecycle Data 0.3.0 (2026-11-13)
entry.summary: Ebb lifecycle data release 0.3.0: 45 added rules, 18 changed rules across cargo, golang, maven.
entry.content: Data release 0.3.0 covers lazy_static, io/ioutil, log4j 1.2, and expanded review provenance.

entry.title: Ebb Lifecycle Data 0.2.0 (2026-11-11)
entry.summary: Ebb lifecycle data release 0.2.0: 652 rules added expanding to 25 ecosystems.
entry.content: Massive multi-ecosystem dataset expansion covering 25 languages and package managers.
